reuse.why: Holidays are added to the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and to a shared isNonWorkingDay that replaces the private isWeekday and every inline d.isWeekend check.

duplication.why: The off-day test is defined once, but each of the four call sites has to thread config.holidays itself and the search windows are widened by separate ad hoc margins in getNextDate and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend helper; server code only forwards the field.

scope.why: Only the weekend helpers, their callers, the recur data plumbing, the type and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One predicate and one stepping loop are easy to own; the per-site skip/move dispatch inherited from the tree means a new caller must still remember to pass holidays.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All former d.isWeekend checks and getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls now go through the shared helpers with holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: None added; the pre-existing per-site skipWeekend/daily dispatch is unchanged, not copied.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay (and getDateWithSkippedWeekend built on it) in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template getEffectiveDate.
